name: atrium
description: A calm, professional theme for appointment businesses on Vuuut: studios, clinics, salons and consultants.

color_scheme.description: Where every reader starts. Each can switch with the light/dark button.

use_site_accent.description: Use the site's accent colour instead of Atrium's pine green.

booking_address.description: Address of the booking pages, as set in Tools → Booking.

hero_heading.default: Care that fits around your life
hero_heading.description: The homepage headline. The last three words are set in italics.

hero_text.description: A line or two under the headline. Leave empty for the built-in line.

hero_image.description: The homepage's main picture. Defaults to the first featured service.

visit_address.description: Your address, for the Visit us block. Leave empty to hide the block.

visit_hours.description: Opening hours in one line, for the Visit us block.

visit_phone.description: A phone number for the Visit us block and the footer.

show_journal.description: Shows your latest posts on the homepage.
